items.feedTitle: Pentagon presses Congress to keep measure changing name to Department of War
items.summary: The Pentagon is lobbying Congress to keep provisions in the annual defense policy bill that would formally change the Department of Defense to the Department of War. President Trump and Secretary of War Pete Hegseth have backed the name change. The proposal remains part of ongoing legislative negotiations.

items.title: Congress may investigate banks and ports over Russian diesel imports
items.feedTitle: Democrats, Tillis say Congress may investigate banks and ports for Russian diesel imports
items.summary: Democrats and Republican Senator Thom Tillis have warned major banks and U.S. port authorities that Congress may investigate imports of Russian diesel fuel after President Trump indicated the U.S. would pursue such imports. Letters sent to financial institutions and port operators flagged potential legal risks.

items.title: Judge rules Trump DOJ unlawfully fired FBI director's daughter
items.feedTitle: Trump DOJ unlawfully fired Epstein prosecutor Maurene Comey, judge rules
items.summary: A federal judge has ruled that the Department of Justice unlawfully terminated Maurene Comey, daughter of former FBI Director James Comey, as a federal prosecutor last year. The court ordered the DOJ to provide back pay. The judge rejected the Trump administration's legal arguments for the firing.

items.title: Trump says decision nearing on Iran: diplomacy or military action
items.feedTitle: Trump says he'll soon decide whether to ‘make a deal’ with Iran or ‘finish it off'
items.summary: President Trump says he will soon decide whether to pursue diplomatic negotiations with Iran or 'finish it off' militarily. Reports indicate the U.S. military has plans for major strikes on Iran if Trump orders them. The decision comes amid escalating rhetoric and regional tensions ahead of the midterm elections.

stlouis.title: St. Louis police board attorney resigns amid raise investigation
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis police board attorney resigns amid investigation into police chief's $112,000 raise
stlouis.summary: The board attorney for the St. Louis City Board of Police Commissioners has resigned amid an ongoing investigation into the police chief's $112,000 raise. The departure marks turmoil at the oversight body as scrutiny intensifies over compensation decisions and governance.

stlouis.title: Missouri voters to decide fate of Trump-backed congressional map
stlouis.feedTitle: Proposition A will determine fate of Missouri’s Trump-backed congressional map
stlouis.summary: Proposition A will determine whether Missouri's Trump-backed congressional redistricting plan stands. Republicans spent millions campaigning against the measure but have made little effort to pass it since the vote was approved, signaling possible acceptance of the new map.

stlouis.title: Illinois State Police breaks ground on $55 million East St. Louis headquarters
stlouis.feedTitle: Illinois State Police building $55 million local headquarters in East St. Louis

items.title: Brazil's Lula wins fourth term in dramatic election comeback
items.feedTitle: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback
items.summary: Left-wing incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won a historic fourth term as Brazil's president, overturning a first-round defeat to right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro in a narrow, dramatic victory. The result is being hailed internationally as a significant signal about the strength of democratic institutions in Latin America. Lula has pledged that dictatorship and fascism will never return to Brazil.

items.summary: Church officials say that more than 60 Christians have been killed in a massacre in Ethiopia, with one resident describing it as an ambush in which they were surrounded. The incident represents a severe loss of civilian lives in the region. Responsibility and full details remain under investigation.

items.summary: Rohingya refugees in Indian-administered Kashmir are reportedly being forced to dismantle their homes amid an eviction threat. The situation reflects ongoing tensions around refugee status and residency rights in the disputed region.

items.title: Cyclone Arnab closes in on Andhra Pradesh coast as very severe storm
items.feedTitle:
Odisha, Andhra shut schools, ban fishing as Cyclone 'Arnab' nears; Centre stresses zero casualties
 | LIVE
items.summary: Very severe cyclonic storm Arnab is expected to make landfall near the Andhra Pradesh-Yanam coast by October 28 as a very severe cyclone. Schools have been shut and relief measures intensified across vulnerable districts in three North Andhra regions. Authorities have mobilized personnel and equipment as the IMD warns of extremely heavy rainfall in several districts.

items.title: India clears ₹2.12 lakh crore defence procurement, 300 more Vajra guns

items.summary: India's Defence Acquisition Council has cleared defence procurement proposals worth ₹2.12 lakh crore, including orders for 300 additional Vajra self-propelled howitzers. The mega artillery push reflects India's focus on strengthening military capabilities and self-reliance in defence manufacturing.

items.title: India allows E100 flex-fuel vehicles to run on ethanol fuel
items.feedTitle: Govt allows flex-fuel vehicles that can run on E100, amends motor vehicle rules | India News
items.summary: The Indian government has amended motor vehicle rules to allow flex-fuel vehicles that can run on E100 (100% ethanol). The regulatory approval comes ahead of planned launches by automakers and reflects India's push toward alternative fuels and renewable energy integration in transportation.

items.title: India-US trade deal: most discussions concluded, fine-tuning underway
items.feedTitle: India-US trade deal: Most discussions concluded, fine-tuning underway, says Piyush Goyal
items.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal says most discussions on a comprehensive India-US trade agreement have been concluded, with fine-tuning still underway. The negotiations reflect India's priority to secure beneficial terms on manufacturing, infrastructure, and digital technologies as part of broader strategic partnership.

immigration.title: Trump administration ends H-1B extension protections, finalizes work-permit restrictions (finalized, in effect)
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Administration Moves to End H-1B Extension Protections, Finalizes Restrictions on Work Permit Renewals
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has finalized restrictions ending the H-1B grace period and removing deference to prior approvals for visa extension renewals. The rule, published October 30, 2025, also eliminates automatic extension of employment authorization documents (EADs) for aliens who timely file renewal applications. These changes are now in effect and significantly impact H-1B and work-permit holders.

immigration.title: Minnesota dentist arrested by ICE at green card interview meeting
immigration.feedTitle: Minnesota dentist arrested by ICE at green card meeting, separated from family
immigration.summary: A Canadian-born dentist was taken into ICE custody at his green card interview in Minneapolis, separated from his family. The arrest highlights growing enforcement actions at immigration benefit interviews. His wife reported the incident, raising concerns about due process at official immigration proceedings.

immigration.feedTitle: US Green Card wait: EB-3 advances 21 days for Indians, no movement for EB-2
immigration.summary: The November 2026 visa bulletin shows EB-3 green card priority dates advancing 21 days for Indian nationals, while EB-2 dates remain stalled at 2013. Family-sponsored categories show modest movement. These are the currently governing cutoff dates that determine visa processing and green card filing eligibility for Indian applicants.

items.feedTitle: Anthropic filing for US stock market listing reveals rapid revenue gains and even larger losses

cards.title: Stress and vigilance drain immune function
cards.insight: Chronic workplace stress and hyper-vigilance—especially in high-stakes jobs like emergency services or law enforcement—depress immune response by raising cortisol and disrupting sleep. The body's repair systems get sidelined when alarm stays activated.
cards.takeaway: Schedule one non-negotiable 20-minute break daily away from screens and alerts; pair it with a walk or breath work to signal 'all clear' to your nervous system.

cards.title: Movement beats supplements for joint health
cards.insight: Sedentary jobs accelerate cartilage breakdown and muscle atrophy around joints, often more than age alone. Regular, varied movement (walking, stairs, gentle resistance) maintains both mobility and proprioception—your body's sense of where it is in space.
cards.takeaway: Stand and change position every 60 minutes; aim for at least 30 minutes of mixed-intensity activity most days—not all at once.

cards.title: Sleep debt compounds like financial debt
cards.insight: Missing even two hours per night across a week impairs decision-making, mood regulation, and metabolic control as much as mild sleep deprivation studies show. One 'catch-up' night does not erase a week of deficit.
cards.takeaway: Aim for consistent sleep timing (within one hour) seven nights a week; consistency matters more than perfect duration.

cards.title: Social connection is a biological need, not a luxury
cards.insight: Isolation and loneliness activate the same physiological stress response as physical threat, raising inflammation and cortisol for hours. Regular, unstructured time with trusted people buffers against both depression and cardiovascular disease.
cards.takeaway: Commit to one unstructured social interaction per week—a meal, walk, or call—not an obligation, but a non-negotiable investment in resilience.

The decision comes after weeks of discussion about security vulnerabilities. The move follows reports that one of OpenAI's engineers previously said such a solution would not be viable.

ai.title: Grok AI chooses Republicans; GPT favors Democrats in election races
ai.feedTitle: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
ai.summary: A new study found that Grok's AI model overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates in political races, while OpenAI's GPT-4 favors Democratic candidates. The two AI systems disagreed in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races tested, highlighting the influence of training data and design choices on political bias in generative AI.
